Packing check for the 1x3 parts that steps name as 1x3 (steps[1],[6],[8],[13],[25]): 18 long pieces of 27.5 to 28.75 in (8 side rails + 4 back rails + 2 top front rails + 2 stretchers 28.75 + 2 drawer top rails 27.5) and 22 short pieces of 13 to 14.5 in (16 stiles 14.5 + 6 drawer stiles 13). A 96 in board holds at most 3 long pieces (4 x 27.5 + kerf > 96), or 2 long + 2 short, or 1 long + 4 short, or 6 to 7 short. With 9 boards and 18 long pieces every board must be the 2 long + 2 short pattern (9 x 2 = 18 long), which yields only 18 short pieces, 4 fewer than the 22 needed; so 9 boards are not enough (a search over all patterns gives 10). Reader calculation; assumes Drawer Front Bottom Rails come from the 1x2 as steps[25] says (otherwise worse).
